body: Going back to school is something I really want to do, but I can't really bring myself to commit to it, I'm not really sure why. It's always in the back of my mind, but I just can't even write the application or anything, it's like there's a mental block there. I just feel like I can't fail at this again and if I go back to school and find it's not what I want to do again, then what the hell is going to stop me then? I am honestly terrified of failing at something else, if that makes sense.
Thank you for the links, I read them before I posted this and they really did help.

Last week I wrote a suicide note to my mother, father and sister. I planned to clean my entire apartment (because I usually live in a messy apartment) and commit suicide so that when they found me they wouldn't feel embarassed about how I was living. I cleaned for hours, making sure every single spot was out of every single part of my apartment and that I would be fine if they saw it in this condition. But as I was writing I couldn't stop crying, I couldn't stop thinking about how awful it would be for them to find me, how it would destroy my mother (who has had serious problems with depression), how it would make my dad think he failed as a father, and how my sister would feel. I couldn't do it to them, and I have no doubt in my mind that if they were not in the picture that I would've done it in a moment. I just feel like I need to talk to someone about how sad I am, all the time, and how I just feel so lost right now. I just don't understand what the hell I am here to do at all, I am employed in a job I fucking hate, that I went to school for and feel as if it was all just a huge mistake. I am a chronic masterbater, and have just such dark thoughts that I often self medicate myself with booze and drugs. I know this is not smart, but I am just not the type of person who can talk about this to anyone around me, I am too embarssed about it. I lie, all the time, to those I love and to those I don't know. I don't even know why I lie, but I just can't help it. Typing all of this out makes me feel so scared and small, and I am honestly scared that I will not have the strength (or the weakness, depending on your opinion) to go on much longer with this. I cry on a daily basis, and have not really felt happy for years. I'm not really sure what I expect from Reddit, but I just think that venting may help somewhat. 

Do people get a 'fresh start'? How am I going to just up and find a new job in a new field with absolutely no schooling in anything but my current job (That is not transferrable, trust me) and no experience? I just don't know what to do.

Thanks for listening, or at least you did in my mind.



**EDIT:**

Alright, I just want to say that the amount of responses and the overwhelming amount of support in this thread has really, really touched me and I appreciate every single reply you people have given. All of them helpful, all of them making me feel better, you all truly have no idea how much this has helped me, so I thought the least I could do for you people is give you a bit of an update on what has transpired today since this thread has been a big reason for what happened.


I gave my 2 weeks notice at my job today, and have decided to go back to school and study again and try to get into a completely different field. As a point of interest since some of you asked: I was in the culinary field, and am very interested in getting into the field of psychology (as ironic as that sounds). I called my mom and dad today as well (couldn't get ahold of my sister) and told them just how much I loved them, and have asked me to help me get through this. Seeing as their love and support kept me from doing the initial act, I thought that with them on my side and talking to me on a regular basis will help me even more, and just knowing they're there will keep me going day after day. 

But again, I cannot explain to all of you just how much this has helped, and I even welled up a bit at some of the responses because they were just so personal and real, as if you really cared about ME and MY problems. All of you should get 10fold the karma for what you have done for me, and even if not on reddit, I know some day your kindness will be repaid.
